## Problem or Need

Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
Example: "We want to export quarantine debts into a specific CI report format..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Core Invariant Check

- [ ] Does this proposal maintain zero runtime dependencies?
- [ ] Does it operate offline without mandatory network access?
- [ ] Does it avoid altering actual test execution outcomes?
- [ ] Does it protect user privacy (no PII)?
